scope: Motel real UDP lifecycle acceptance and two additional fixed-position RNG-seed complete QA routes. Full vertical slice remains active.

network.topology: One listen host and three remote UDP peers, within one process per platform.
fixture_actions: Spawn surrendered civilian at a visible test position and aim host at that actor.
Direct lid/body damage, physical masonry cut and sound emission establish repeatable state.
ordinary_actions: Transport join, disconnect and epoch restart
checks: Directed target reaches observer; human takeover clears queued task before Execute.
Late join reconstructs full motel geometry with one removed lid and an open capsule-traversable aperture.
Existing peers consume breach cue once; late hearing memory suppresses historical cue and consumes a new impact once.
Removing the body removes supported lids; restart restores body/lids and closed masonry for every peer.
Disconnect restores bot ownership without stale directed target.
network.state_comparison_scope: Entire encoded simulation snapshot after removing sound history; join floor, epoch, hearing and raw cue deduplication checked separately. Generic capture normalizes transport metadata.

test_wait_fix.reason: The helper sampled before all replicas were active within a five-second total wait. Three sequential world rebuilds share its thread. Extend test-helper wait to 15 seconds and report elapsed readiness; production six-second client timeout remains unchanged.

limits: Both seed runs use authored occupant positions and randomize=false; initial resolve and subsequent RNG vary. They are not varied-layout or held-out learned-policy evaluation.
The QA driver knows the room plan. Linux runs validate every-tick replay, mid-run save/resume and final replica/debrief; Windows independently replays those journals.
UDP lifecycle cases establish damage/cut/sounds directly; they are not a four-player full ordinary-input mission completion.
Sound tests use actual received event metadata and hearing memory; audio-device playback is not tested.
No GPU, graphical or performance test was run. Heavy performance testing remains held.
Manual playtesting is optional feedback; full-slice acceptance remains open.
